response.sql: WITH large AS (SELECT k_symbol, amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802), per AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM large GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall FROM per) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall AS excess_over_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC;

assumptions.assumption: A 'large' standing order is one with amount strictly greater than 2802 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
The blank purpose code is the empty string '' (k_symbol is NOT NULL, so no NULLs need handling) and is grouped as its own k_symbol value.
The overall figure is the simple unweighted average of the per-purpose averages, computed over purposes that have at least one large order.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Large' includes the cutoff, so orders with amount equal to 2802 also count (amount greater than or equal to 2802).
